hook: A formula for the LoRA rank you actually need

beats.say: Engram derived a theory for computing the minimum LoRA rank needed to fine-tune on any supervised dataset.
The idea: adapter size depends on how many bits the dataset takes to encode under the base model. Some data, like RL data, fits in a rank one adapter.
In practice, the method predicts the needed rank across settings with error rates below 5 percent.
